summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile UI regression for AFT after Google Auth + bill-level discount + Settings + PDF refactor. All 25 pytest cases pass (auth gating, discount math for percent/fixed/none, negative-input rejection, stock aggregation, CSV+PDF exports, settings CRUD, legacy-order fallback). Mobile UI end-to-end SaleBuilder flow (Paneer Chaumin → Full → Quality 8 → Qty 3 → 10% discount → Tip ₹20) produced Subtotal ₹240 · Discount ₹24 · Final ₹216 · Collect ₹236 and persisted correctly. Reports shows DISCOUNT metric card and no longer red-screens on date change. Settings page renders with Google-auth status, brand + category editors and Danger Zone reset. No blocker or high-priority issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~480 lines - still manageable but nearing the 700-line guidance; consider splitting orders/reports/exports into routers as more features land.
Delivery orders currently apply discount before adding delivery_charge (grand_total = net_sales + tips + delivery_charge); this matches spec and works, verified by unit math.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (login gating, dashboard, sale builder, discount+tip, save, sales history, reports date change, PDF export button, settings)
